profile.visual_desc: Blue-armored knight riding a bipedal blue dragon. The dragon has large leathery wings and a pale underbelly. The knight wears full plate with a pointed helmet.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Close-up of a silver-grey knight helmet. A narrow horizontal visor reveals a single glowing red eye in the shadow.
profile.weapon_desc: A massive, grey conical lance held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: The dragon hovers with wings tucked. The knight sits tall, holding the lance vertically in a neutral guard.
profile.step2_windup: The dragon spreads its wings wide. The knight pulls the lance back toward the shoulder, preparing a heavy thrust.
profile.step3_impact: The dragon lunges forward. The knight thrusts the lance down-right. A sharp grey and white impact spark appears at the tip.
profile.step4_finish: The dragon beats its wings to retreat. The knight pulls the lance back to his side as the impact effect disappears.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The thrust effect in Frame 4 must align perfectly with the linear trajectory of the lance tip directed down-right.

evaluation.diagnosis: The animation captures essential thrust mechanics. Minor perspective shifts occur during wind-up, but weapon handling and VFX alignment remain consistent.
